releases.name: v0.1.1 — README with screenshots
releases.body: Only the documentation changed: the README now shows real rendered screenshots (a session screen, before and after, the three palettes, the logo gradients) in place of ASCII art that broke on npm. The plugin code is the same as v0.1.0.

releases.name: v0.1.0 — first release
releases.body:
First public release of the btop-style skin for the OpenCode TUI. It restyles what is already on screen and adds nothing.

- **Cards:** rounded borders tinted with each card's title colour, and the header set into the top border (`╭─┐ ▼ Title ┌──┐ v1.2 ┌─╮`). Collapse clicks still work.
- **Sidebar sections:** Context, MCP and plugin sections (Checklist-to-Goal…) are boxed the same way. The layout never changes, so sections that rebuild every second don't make the screen jump.
- **Bars:** magic-context's token bar and any `█░` text bar are repainted as `■` meters.
- **Logo:** a gradient from your theme (`logoHue`) or a named one.
- Every colour follows the active theme, and disabling the plugin restores everything it touched.

```jsonc
{ "plugins": ["beautify-opencode"] }
```

Requires OpenCode 2.x.
